requirements: Windows 10/11 x64. Python 3.12 (64-bit, from python.org; 3.10+ works) must be installed and reachable as `py` or `python`. Unzip and run Eclipse.exe (unsigned - SmartScreen may ask you to confirm). On first run Eclipse creates a private Python environment in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Eclipse\venv and pip-installs numpy, mujoco, gymnasium and cl-sdk (internet required, a few hundred MB, a few minutes; progress is shown in the Studio log). Your runs and imported robots are stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Eclipse\data. If Python is missing, Eclipse shows a dialog linking to python.org.
